Definition: irregular plural of G4771; you (as subjective of verb):--ye (yourselves), you.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hymeîs is the word for you, ye yourselves. It appears in Matthew, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I read hymeîs plainly — it means you, ye yourselves, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
